summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the K-12 virtual schooling and career-learning operating stack. Stride is the reference anchor because it directly combines virtual K-12, career learning, professional skills, and school/district services. The underfollowed lane points to companies whose exposure is partly hidden in employer education benefits, education payment/admin infrastructure, or vocational career pathways rather than being labeled as pure online K-12 platforms.
